worker_output.summary: Implemented full CombatScreen per combat-algorithm.md and combat-mechanics.md. Added: movement range visualization (BFS from ship position within combat_speed hexes), click-to-move, click-to-fire with per-weapon attack resolution, floating damage numbers (hit/miss), explosion particle effects on ship destruction, retreat button (fleet retreat per §28-29), and range bracket labels (Point Blank/Close/Medium/Long/Very Long). Existing features retained: hex grid rendering, ship selection, initiative strip, combat log, auto-resolve, results overlay.

design_compliance.quote: Movement_Points = Combat_Speed + Maneuver_Bonus. Each hex moved costs 1 movement point.
design_compliance.impl_line: getReachableHexes() — BFS limited to ship.speed steps

design_compliance.quote: hit_threshold = 101 - hit_chance; success_range = max(hit_chance - 1, 1); damage_fraction = (roll - hit_threshold) / success_range; base_damage = weapon.damage_min + floor(damage_fraction × (weapon.damage_max - weapon.damage_min))
design_compliance.impl_line: resolveWeaponAttack() — MOO1 damage mapped to roll
resolveWeaponAttack() delegates to calcHitChanceVs() from combat.ts

design_compliance.section: Section 11: Damage Sequence — shields absorb first
design_compliance.impl_line: resolveWeaponAttack() delegates to applyDamage() from combat.ts; shield absorbed shown in damage numbers
doRetreat() — calls attemptRetreat() from combat.ts per ship

design_compliance.quote: Point Blank (1 hex), Close (2-4), Medium (5-8), Long (9-15), Very Long (16+)
design_compliance.impl_line: rangeBracket() function + RANGE_* constants + hexDistance() using cube coord conversion

design_compliance.quote: Ships are positioned on a hexagonal grid. Small battle: 20x20 hexes.
design_compliance.impl_line: GRID_COLS=15, GRID_ROWS=11 (compact for demo), flat-top hex geometry

design_gaps.gap: Initiative formula (§4) includes Random = roll(1,6) — the UI initiative strip sorts by speed only (deterministic) for display clarity. Full random initiative is implemented in processRound() in combat.ts.
design_gaps.choice: Display strip sorts by speed desc as approximation; actual combat round uses full formula via processRound().
